name: queue-management-loadtesting
description: Load testing of CSRs on the queue-management application.

scripts.tests: mkdir -p output && . ./envs.sh && node run-artillery.js csr-http.yaml --output output/report-http.json -k
scripts.tests:all: mkdir -p output && . ./envs.sh && node run-artillery.js csr-test-all.yaml --output output/report.json -k
scripts.tests:http: mkdir -p output && . ./envs.sh && node run-artillery.js csr-http.yaml --output output/report-http.json -k
scripts.tests:socket: mkdir -p output && . ./envs.sh && node run-artillery.js csr-socket.yaml --output output/report-socket.json -k

author: Adam Coard
